1.name: Turf Beach
1.ov: Despite having trained for two months, Toraji still can't memorize a whole story. His boss asks him to investigate Ginjiro, who is acting strange.

1.name: The Manju We Fear
1.ov: Toraji is tasked with causing trouble at his superior’s wedding party. Later, he learns a rakugo story about a man with an odd fear of steamed buns.

1.name: Tea Ceremony
1.ov: Ryuji's big chance arrives when his fashion brand catches the attention of a famous producer. Donbei takes on a new, highly skilled apprentice.

1.name: Gonsuke's Lantern
1.ov: Toraji has a hard time understanding the concept of marriage in one of his stories. Donbei reveals a startling secret about his college days.

1.name: A Stable Fire
1.ov: After seeing a married couple perform at his first-ever manzai comedy show, an impressed Toraji decides to be their manager to find them more gigs.

1.name: A Crow Cawing at Daybreak
1.ov: Toraji convinces his boss to let Ginjiro handle a job on his own. Concerned that Donkichi is in his 40s and single, Ryuji and Donta plan a group date.

1.name: Cat's Plate
1.ov: The Rakugo Association decides to hold a contest to recruit young talent. Toraji tries asking Ryuji to return to the stage, but he’s flatly declined.

1.name: Sudden Impulse
1.ov: In a bid to impress his father, Ginjiro acts on information gained from an old friend to extort a rival gang, but he soon finds himself in a pinch.

1.name: Careless Tenement House
1.ov: A starving Yasuo suddenly appears before Toraji and tells him that he’s on the run from his gang. Later, Ryuji’s clothing store is ransacked by thugs.

1.name: Shinagawa Double Suicide
1.ov: With the Shinjuku Ryuseikai on the verge of collapsing, Toraji must make a difficult decision. Ryuji resolves to return to the world of rakugo.

1.name: The Child Is a Clamp
1.ov: Three years later, Toraji leaves prison to find that a lot has changed. He visits the rakugo hall and makes a heartbreaking discovery.
